description: This source file contains functions related to cache manipulation, specifically for flushing CPU caches on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards. It includes a cache operation macro and a function to perform cache line flushing for a specified memory region.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes the cache lines covering a specified memory range by performing cache write-back and invalidation for each cache line within the range.
